summary: model_name is consumed in exactly one place on the training side (TransformerObsEncoder.__init__ -> timm.create_model, transformer_obs_encoder.py:91-96) and rebuilt with pretrained=False on the station (rov_gui/perception/dp_policy.py:672-681); every other consumer (policy max_cond_tokens, denoiser cond_pos_emb, EMA, optimizer groups, checkpoint save, describe()/run meta) derives shape from the encoder's example forward, so swapping to a DINOv3 ViT (timm 'vit_large_patch16_dinov3' / 'vit_huge_plus_patch16_dinov3' / 'vit_7b_patch16_dinov3', class timm.models.eva.Eva, 201 tokens = CLS+4 reg+196 patches at 224, RoPE with coords normalised to [-1,1] so 224 needs no pos-embed resampling, non-persistent rope buffer so strict load is clean) is CONFIG-ONLY for the network graph: the 1024/1280/4096->768 projection is auto-created (line 197-199), cond_pos_emb becomes (1,411,768), n_obs_tokens 410. The hard blockers are environmental, not architectural: (1) the training env umi2 has timm 0.9.7 which has no dinov3 models — needs timm >= 1.0.20 (DINOv3 added in v1.0.20; pin 1.0.29 to match rovgui-pose); upgrading is safe for existing checkpoints because vit_base_patch16_clip_224.openai (151 keys) and resnet34.a1_in1k (216 keys) state-dict keys/shapes are identical between 0.9.7 and 1.0.29 and the real data/20260910/0910_095252_train_umi_depth_5d_depth5d_9926_A_vitclip ViT-CLIP checkpoint's backbone keys equal timm 1.0.29's; (2) resources on the single RTX 5090 + 87 GB free disk: ViT-L (303M) is feasible with care (~3.0 GB per ckpt x21 = 62 GB, fp32 training memory unmeasured/borderline), H+ (840M) needs topk reduction (7.3 GB/ckpt x21 = 153 GB > disk) and almost certainly bf16/grad-checkpointing (code), and 7B (6.7B, 26.9 GB fp32 weights) is infeasible without deep code changes (construction deep-copies the encoder at transformer_obs_encoder.py:187 and the workspace deep-copies the whole policy for EMA at workspace:82 -> 3 x 27 GB CPU, 54 GB GPU; deploy loader is fp32-only, dp_policy.py:755, beside a 7.5 GB station process). Two code-level traps: `frozen: True` in the config makes the deploy loader crash (dp_policy passes `frozen` through with pretrained=False; transformer_obs_encoder.py:99-100 asserts pretrained), and register tokens ride into the decoder as conditioning tokens unless aggregate_feature is edited. Parity fixture regeneration (dp_policy_reference.py in umi2) also requires the timm upgrade.

facts.fact: The only training-side consumer of model_name is timm.create_model(model_name, pretrained, global_pool='', num_classes=0); the name is stored and later only tested with startswith('resnet'|'convnext'|'vit').

For any name starting with 'vit' and feature_aggregation=null, aggregate_feature returns ALL backbone tokens unchanged; 'cls' returns feature[:, [0], :]. Any other aggregation is coerced to 'cls' with a warning.

The projection to n_emb is inferred from an example CPU forward of zeros(1,3,224,224): feature_size != n_emb -> nn.Linear(feature_size, n_emb) under key_projection_map.<rgb_key>. For DINOv3 L/H+/7B this auto-creates Linear(1024|1280|4096 -> 768) — no code needed. The current CLIP run has NO image projection (768==768; checkpoint key_projection_map only holds the 3 lowdim Linear pairs).

The deploy loader rebuilds the encoder with pretrained=False and forwards every other obs_encoder cfg key (including `frozen`) as kwargs; therefore a checkpoint trained with frozen: True raises AssertionError at station load. Currently frozen: False so it does not trigger.
facts.evidence: rov_gui/perception/dp_policy.py:675-681 (enc_kwargs excludes only _target_, transforms, shape_meta, pretrained, use_group_norm, force_group_norm); config train_diffusion_transformer_umi_depth_vit_workspace.yaml:57

facts.fact: use_group_norm=True replaces only nn.BatchNorm2d; timm Eva (DINOv3 ViT) has no BatchNorm so the swap is a no-op, and describe()['encoder_batchnorm_kept'] would report True (cosmetic, misleading).

Policy derives obs_tokens from obs_encoder.output_shape() and passes max_cond_tokens=obs_tokens+1 to the denoiser, whose cond_pos_emb is nn.Parameter (1, max_cond_tokens, n_emb). With DINOv3 at horizon 2 and 4 lowdim keys: 2*201 + 4*2 = 410 obs tokens, cond_pos_emb (1,411,768). The real CLIP ckpt has cond_pos_emb (1,403,768) = 2*197+8+1, confirming the arithmetic.

Optimizer groups: every param whose name starts with 'key_model_map' gets obs_encoder_lr (3e-5) and obs_encoder_weight_decay (1e-6); the new image projection Linear and lowdim projections go to the other group at base lr 3e-4. DINOv3 LayerScale gamma_1/gamma_2, reg_token, cls_token and LayerNorms all receive the 1e-6 decay (no exclusion).

The workspace deep-copies the entire policy for EMA (a second full encoder copy) and moves both to the GPU; Accelerator is created without mixed_precision (fp32 training); no allow_tf32/autocast/grad-checkpointing anywhere in the training code.
facts.evidence: train_diffusion_transformer_timm_workspace.py:80-82, :97, :202-207; grep for allow_tf32|autocast|mixed_precision|grad_checkpointing in workspace/encoder/train.py returned nothing

facts.fact: freeze_encoder=True only sets eval() + requires_grad_(False) each epoch; the frozen params stay in the optimizer (AdamW skips None grads) and EMAModel.step copies (not averages) params with requires_grad False. EMA averages named_parameters() only.

Checkpoints store both state_dicts.model and state_dicts.ema_model in fp32 (cpu copies, saved on a thread) with topk k=20 plus latest.ckpt = 21 files per run. The ViT-B CLIP run's files are 1.219 GB each (85.8M encoder + 66.5M denoiser); the 11 kept files occupy 13 GB.
Per-checkpoint size arithmetic (model+ema, fp32): DINOv3-L ~3.0 GB (21 files ~62 GB); H+ ~7.3 GB (~153 GB); 7B ~54 GB (~1.1 TB). The data volume has 87 GB free (96% full).

facts.fact: RoPE at 224 needs no resampling: RotaryEmbeddingDinoV3 builds coords per forward from the actual grid, normalised 'separate' to [-1,1] per axis ((i+0.5)/H), so a 14x14 grid spans the same range as the 16x16 pretraining grid (per-patch angular step 2/14 vs 2/16 [유도]). rope.periods is a NON-persistent buffer -> absent from state_dict -> strict load unaffected; timm notes original weights had bf16 periods, timm regenerates fp32.

H+ (840M): 21 x 7.3 GB = 153 GB of checkpoints vs 87 GB free -> must cut checkpoint.topk.k (config) or the run dies mid-way; static GPU footprint ~17 GB fp32 (weights+EMA+grads+Adam) leaves ~15 GB for 128-image activations through 32 x 1280-d layers -> OOM expected at batch 64 [예측]; fixes are bf16 autocast / model.set_grad_checkpointing(True) (code, or possibly ACCELERATE_MIXED_PRECISION=bf16 env for accelerate 0.24.1 — unverified) or batch reduction (config).

L (303M): fits on disk only barely (62 GB of 87 GB, with 13 GB of ViT-CLIP ckpts already there); fp32 batch 64x2 training memory unmeasured and borderline [예측]; throughput ~3.5x ViT-B FLOPs -> ~6 min/epoch, ~19 h for 200 epochs [예측]. Measure peak memory with a 1-epoch debug run before committing.

Deploy assert trap: any DINOv3 config with frozen: True crashes DpPolicySession.load (dp_policy.py:675-681 passes frozen with pretrained=False; encoder asserts at transformer_obs_encoder.py:99-100). Needs one-line code change (drop 'frozen' from enc_kwargs) if freezing is chosen.

Register tokens leak into conditioning: with feature_aggregation null the 4 register tokens per frame (8 total) become decoder memory tokens; dropping them (feature[:, 5:] or CLS+patches) needs code in aggregate_feature; 'cls' aggregation alone is a 2-token conditioning and discards spatial detail.

Any NEW obs_encoder config key (e.g. a register-drop flag) is forwarded verbatim to TransformerObsEncoder by the station (dp_policy.py:675-681) -> TypeError at load unless the upstream class signature accepts it; encoder changes must land in external/UMI_aquatic (the vendored repo dp_policy imports from), not only in training.

Pretraining mismatch: DINOv3 expects ImageNet mean/std RGB at 256; pipeline feeds unnormalised [0,1] depth-encoding at 224 (RoPE handles 224 natively). Adding Normalize is a config change on the training side but must be mirrored in dp_policy's transforms (code) — currently CenterCrop/Resize only.

Parity/regression tooling: dp_policy_reference.py (umi2) must be rerun after the timm upgrade to regenerate rov_gui/tests/data/dp_policy_ref.npz; TOL_TOKENS 5e-3 was calibrated on a 21M resnet and may fail for a 24/32-layer ViT across torch 2.9 vs 2.11 TF32 paths [예측]; test_dp_policy.py:591 breaks only if POLICY_CKPT_DEFAULT is repointed at a non-resnet run.

EMA doubles GPU memory for a giant encoder and (with obs_encoder_lr 3e-5, EMA power 0.75) slows the encoder's effective adaptation; use_ema is a config switch but selection protocols (selected.json) currently rank on 'model' weights anyway.

Weight decay 1e-6 and lr 3e-5 apply uniformly to LayerScale gammas, register/cls tokens and LayerNorms of the backbone (no param-group exclusions) — harmless at 1e-6 but any larger decay would need code.

License: timm tags the weights 'dinov3-license' (Meta DINOv3 License, not Apache); the HF mirrors are ungated so nothing technical blocks the download, but the checkpoint provenance/meta should record the license tag.
